narrative.overview: Daily AI Lab turns learning AI tools into a daily, game-like habit, anchored on Riri, a round yellow cockatiel in a violet superhero cape. The UI is a soft, pillowy sticker book: everything rounded and lifted, high-energy sun/hero color on calm violet-tinted neutrals. It is Thai-first and rejects corporate SaaS minimalism, bluish gradients, cold grays, pure black, and decorative glassmorphism.
keyCharacteristics: Pillowy and rounded: pills for buttons/chips, 20-28px on cards, nothing boxy.
Tactile 3D controls with a solid colored key that depresses on press.
Mascot-led: Riri's emotional poses are the illustration system.
Bright accents on a near-white lavender page (#F7F5FC).
Playful bouncy motion with prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The Violet-Ink-on-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a surface, not a typeface. Violet ink reads on yellow; white reads on violet. Never yellow text on white.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest value is Ink #1B1729. Pure #000 is forbidden, including in shadows.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere including buttons and headings; uppercase only for tiny tracked eyebrows.

rules.name: The Tactile-Key Rule
rules.body: Primary and sunny buttons carry a solid colored offset shadow that grows on hover and shrinks on press. A keyless button is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is violet-tinted (rgba(39,16,96,...)). Neutral or black shadows read as dated.

dos: Do make every button and chip a full pill and give primary/sunny buttons a colored key that depresses on press.
Do keep yellow as a surface and write on it in violet ink; white text on violet.
Do tint every shadow violet and keep the darkest value at Ink #1B1729.
Do lead emotional, empty, success, and error moments with a matched Riri pose.
Do use Baloo 2 for headlines and celebratory numbers, Anuphan for body, JetBrains Mono for code.
Do write sentence case, Thai-first, keeping English tech terms in English.
Do keep bounce easing on playful transitions with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't use pure black #000 anywhere, including shadows; neutrals are violet-tinted, not gray.
Don't put yellow text on white, or use Punch orange as a primary button.
Don't ship boxy or sharp corners.
Don't pair a 1px border with a heavy drop shadow on the same element.
Don't lean on bluish gradients, noisy textures, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't ALL-CAPS sentences or set body copy in uppercase.
Don't replace Riri with stock illustration or recolor/distort the mascot.
